---
name: Feature request
about: A language feature, tool improvement, or docs change
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Motivation**

What are you trying to accomplish? Concrete use cases and the code you have to
write today work better than abstract feature names.

**Proposed solution**

What you would like the language or tools to do. For language-semantics
changes, sketch the syntax and the expected behavior, including how it
interacts with what exists (typing rules, existing constructs with similar
surface syntax).

**Alternatives considered**

Other designs you have seen (other languages count — NLang borrows deliberately
and documents why), and why they fit less well here.

**Scope**

Is this a language-semantics change, a library/stdlib addition, a tooling
improvement, or documentation? Language changes go through a design discussion
before implementation.
